statistics.population: original fold fit participants after frozen declared-positive/retained-negative recording eligibility; every participant must retain at least one recording
statistics.N_F: number of distinct eligible fit participants
statistics.N_F_c: number of distinct eligible fit participants with official class c, c in {0,1}
statistics.early_stop_class_factor: reuse a_c from fit; never estimate class factors on early_stop or outer_eval
statistics.structural_counts: within each allowed role independently: R_role recordings, N_role participants, n_ir eligible windows in recording r, W_i=sum_r n_ir
failures: any outer participant in fit or early_stop role inputs

weights.fit_mining: m_ir is the exact original own-fold fit recording sample_weight, restricted to {1,2}; verify all required entries; no re-mining or sampling duplication
prohibited: renormalizing by sum of mined weights
learning weights from early_stop or outer labels
using recording count instead of window share
equalizing participant mass again after mining

presence.window_probability: p_irw = sigmoid(logsumexp(z_irwt over geometry-valid t) - log(number of geometry-valid t)); temperature=1
presence.recording_probability: p_ir = arithmetic mean of p_irw over all eligible windows of the recording
presence.update_group_loss: L_presence_G = sum_ir_in_G(w_ir*ell_ir)/B_G; B_G is actual number of complete recordings in group, never sum of weights
presence.unequal_durations: window counts determine recording shares within a participant, preserving summed R1 window weights; participant base mass is duration-independent before mining; do not introduce seconds weighting, truncate bags, or duplicate short recordings
presence.inference_participant_probability: unweighted arithmetic mean of all protocol-eligible recording probabilities for that participant, including recordings excluded from presence supervision where original inference allows them

phase.training_recording_eligibility: same fixed supervised recording set as presence; no additional exclusion due TSV validity
phase.targets_masks: unchanged official cardiac-state reader and v1 valid/unknown/boundary/padding masks; no synthetic murmur targets
phase.group_loss: L_phase_G = sum CE over all valid phase frame exposures in G / count of those exposures; zero when count=0
phase.role_loss: sum valid phase CE over role / count valid phase exposures in role; zero when count=0
phase.weights: no class, participant, presence, or mining weights on phase CE
phase.overlap: existing overlapping-window phase exposures retained; no de-duplication inside loss; duration-weighted reconstruction applies only to export

optimizer_groups.fit_epoch_order: sort eligible recording IDs by (SHA256(UTF8('RD-LTMIL-01-v1-B1|fold={fold}|epoch={epoch}|seed={seed}|recording={recording_id}')).hexdigest(), recording_id); decimal fold/epoch/seed without leading zeros
optimizer_groups.grouping: consecutive groups of 32 recording IDs; retain final short group; every recording exactly once per epoch; participants may span groups but never roles
optimizer_groups.gradient_accumulation: precompute group B_G and valid-phase exposure count K_G from metadata/masks; hold weights fixed; process complete recordings sequentially with <=32-window forward microbatches; for each recording accumulate gradient of w_ir*ell_ir/B_G + 0.2*sum(valid phase CE_ir)/K_G (phase term zero when K_G=0); finish every window of a recording before its BCE; no optimizer or clipping between recordings/microbatches
optimizer_groups.optimizer_step: sum float32 gradients across complete group; call existing Adam(learning_rate=0.0001, clipnorm=1.0) exactly once; its clipnorm clips each variable gradient separately once after accumulation, NOT global_clipnorm; do not additionally clip; reset accumulator after step
optimizer_groups.memory: retain at most one recording's differentiable graph plus gradient buffers; never detach window probabilities before recording BCE; no truncated backpropagation
optimizer_groups.last_group: use actual B_G; no padding, oversampling, dropped records or extra update; this is standard variable final minibatch behavior
optimizer_groups.amendment: 32 now explicitly denotes recording bags per optimizer update; 32-window microbatches are a separate computational ceiling

early_stopping.monitor: L_presence_early_stop + 0.2 * L_phase_early_stop, computed over the entire role at a fixed checkpoint
early_stopping.aggregation: sum B_G*L_presence_G then divide by R_early_stop; sum phase numerators and divide by sum valid phase counts; never average batch ratios equally
early_stopping.selection: strictly smaller loss improves; preserve first best on tie; patience=8; maximum_epochs=50

numerics.weight_construction: float64; store at least 17 significant decimal digits; cast coefficients to float32 for model loss
numerics.invalid_values: fail closed on nonfinite tensors/loss/gradients or empty presence masks; never silently drop a recording

materialized_binding_schema.groups: save all 50 deterministic epoch schedules before any fit; early_stop one immutable schedule; no outer labels/TSVs in materializer inputs

acceptance_tests_required: before mining: each participant sums to its class factor; fit class totals both N_F/2; fit sum(recording_coefficients)=R_fit
constant BCE=ln(2), no mining: role fit presence=ln(2)
mining a recording by 2 doubles its numerator contribution without changing any denominator or any other record coefficient
duration scale of every recording within a participant leaves its base mass unchanged; within-participant shares track window counts
group size/count and once-per-epoch identity coverage; final partial group retained; correct role isolation
global role reporting invariant to partitioning: weight group presence by actual recording count, phase by valid frame count
fit class factors reused on early_stop regardless of early_stop prevalence; early_stop multipliers all one
reference full-group gradient matches sequential-record accumulated gradient before clipping and Adam within declared tolerances
Adam iteration increments once per group; no update or BatchNorm-stat change during validation
no-phase frames yield zero phase loss without changing presence population; outer inputs rejected
longest recording, heterogeneous 32-recording group and final short group run without truncation or memory fallback altering objective

compute_acceptance.workload: materialize actual fit/early_stop groups for all five folds; max-50-epoch record/window/frame/update counts; all-recording calibration and final inference/export counted separately
compute_acceptance.bounded_benchmark: after handoff integration: each fold test first, median-window-load, maximum-window-load and final fit groups (deduplicate; final may be full); corresponding early_stop extremes; one compile/warmup group plus at most 4 timed optimizer groups per fold; existing 600-second probe watchdog per fold including preparation, stop and preserve evidence on timeout; no full epoch; never select by probabilities, errors or outer outcomes
compute_acceptance.inference_probe_population: fit/early_stop recordings only for measured final-inference/export rates; project outer export workload from already verified structural counts, without opening outer labels or TSVs or evaluating outer outcomes
measure: peak allocated/reserved GPU memory and free headroom
disk capacity and content-addressed cache bytes
compute_acceptance.projection: use actual group workloads and the slowest measured relevant workload-normalized rates; include cold population of all required fold caches, observed retracing, all 50 validations, up to 250 best checkpoints and final exports; publish uncertainty/headroom and all excluded costs
compute_acceptance.GO_requirement: all mathematical/integration/leakage checks pass AND a defensible conservative final-bound projection including memory/storage acceptance is strictly below 43200 seconds; otherwise NO-GO; never silently shrink folds, epochs, bags or trainable layers

evaluation.threshold: unchanged v1: original early_stop participant predictions only, sensitivity>=0.90 then specificity, precision, smaller threshold
evaluation.historical_R1_FP128: historical pooled-OOF reference only, not a matched operating-point comparison
evaluation.matched_superiority_claim: forbidden unless a separately verified exposure-safe compatible comparator exists
evaluation.temporal_claim: cardiac-phase evaluation against official intervals; murmur timestamps exploratory, no onset/offset accuracy without independent interval references
